title: lethal-trifecta-lint: Linting AI Agent Tool Manifests for the Lethal Trifecta
description: A zero-dependency linter that reads an AI agent's tool manifest (MCP tools/list, OpenAI/Anthropic tools, LangChain export, or a name list), classifies each tool by the three lethal-trifecta capabilities (private-data access, untrusted-content intake, external communication), and fails CI when all three co-occur. Concept: Simon Willison.
